name: Next.js waitlist
summary: A waitlist on Next.js: the form saves an email to Postgres and sends a welcome email through Resend.
runsOn: A Next.js app in Chromium, with Postgres in Docker
shows: An invariant that reads both sides: exactly one row in Postgres and exactly one welcome email in the Resend emulator
`danwo matrix` faulting Resend (429, 500, a lost answer), the app's own SQL through the data proxy, and a double submit
A Postgres snapshot per worker, restored before every test and trial, with no app restart
